Clarification mapping
- No `Q1/Q2/...` clarification questions were asked in this issue.
- `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` maps to “proceed with planning as scoped.”

Implementation checklist
- [ ] Add shared phase-transition helper in `scripts/label_helpers.sh` that avoids full label-set replacement.
- [ ] Replace targeted inline phase-label mutation blocks in `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` and `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` with the shared helper.
- [ ] Update `issue_pr_status` fallback parsing to use event payload title/body first, REST only when payload is unavailable.
- [ ] Add regression tests for phase-label transition behavior and payload-first fallback parsing.

Plan
1. Files likely to change
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh`
- `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
- `tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py` (extend contract checks)
- `tests/test_issue_pr_status_*.py` (new or existing test file for payload-first fallback path)
- `tests/test_label_helpers_*.py` or similar (new/extended regression coverage for transition behavior)

2. Functions/modules to implement
- Add new helper in `scripts/label_helpers.sh` (additive, no rename/removal), e.g. `set_issue_phase_label_resilient <issue> <target_label> [repo]`.
- Helper behavior:
  - Ensure target label exists (`ensure_label_exists` reuse).
  - Add target label via REST add-label endpoint.
  - Remove other known phase labels via targeted remove operations (not PUT full-set).
  - Fail-open fallback: if removal fails, keep target label applied and log warnings.
- Replace inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS + GET/PUT` blocks in:
  - `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` “Update linked issue labels when PR closes”
  - `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` targeted review-blocked/ready-to-merge transitions
- In `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`, change fallback PR parsing:
  - Build `PR_DATA` from `${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}` + `${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}` first.
  - Call `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number}` only if payload fields are empty/unset.

3. Data structures affected
- New shared phase-label list in `scripts/label_helpers.sh` (same phase membership currently hardcoded in workflows).
- No schema or DB contract changes.
- No env var contract changes expected.

4. API/interface changes
- Internal shell helper API added in `label_helpers.sh` (consumed by workflows/scripts).
- GitHub API usage shifts from race-prone “GET labels + PUT full set” to targeted add/remove label operations for scoped transitions.
- `issue_pr_status` fallback keeps existing regex extraction logic; only data source preference changes (event payload first).

5. Risks and edge cases
- Review-autofix failure path currently avoids sourcing helper when support scripts may be missing; replacement must keep a safe fallback path.
- Partial update risk: add succeeds but some removes fail; must preserve backward-compatible behavior by keeping target label present.
- Label names must be URL-encoded for remove endpoint.
- Payload fields may be null/empty on some event shapes; REST fallback must remain intact.

6. Testing considerations
- Extend workflow contract tests to assert targeted workflows call shared helper and no longer contain the scoped inline full-set replacement pattern.
- Add regression test for `issue_pr_status` fallback ordering:
  - Verifies payload-first parsing branch exists.
  - Verifies REST fallback is conditional (not unconditional).
- Add regression test for helper transition logic contract:
  - Verifies target-label add + per-label remove pattern is used.
  - Verifies no full `PUT /issues/{issue}/labels` replacement in the new shared helper path.

Conflict notes
- Same full-set replacement pattern also exists in `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` (`_resilient_phase_swap`). This is outside the current issue scope; leave unchanged unless scope is expanded.
